description: Common English messages and dynamic labels for editing workflow pages.

labels.buttonRerunRuleDiscoveryHelp: Reruns the saved Flow's rule discovery against the INITDN$ editing table.
labels.dmlGeneratedPreview: A production-apply DML was generated from the current editing rules and change history.
labels.dmlBlankAdded: A blank DML was added. Enter an UPDATE statement for the current INITUP$ table, then save it.
labels.dmlRegenerated: The selected DML was reset to the initial SQL generated from the current editing changes. You can validate it or save it immediately.
labels.dmlSaved: The DML name and SQL were saved.
labels.dmlEditNotice: You can save a generated DML or a custom UPDATE. Before execution, the server revalidates the current INITUP$ target and allowed syntax.
labels.dmlSqlRequired: Enter the DML SQL to save.
labels.dmlNoChanges: There are no changes to save.
labels.closedExecutionReadOnly: Completed or reset work is available as read-only history.
labels.dmlValidationSqlRequired: Enter the DML SQL to validate.
labels.dmlValidationSqlTooLarge: The DML SQL exceeds the maximum validation size.
labels.dmlValidationCommentsNotAllowed: Comments are not allowed in production-apply DML.
labels.dmlValidationStructureRequired: Keep the server-generated production-apply PL/SQL structure.
labels.dmlValidationRowCountLocked: The affected-row validation section cannot be changed.
labels.dmlValidationScopeRequired: Keep the current INITUP$/INITDN$ target, correction history, and matched-row update structure.
labels.dmlValidationMatchLocked: The server-generated row match condition cannot be changed.
labels.dmlValidationCommandNotAllowed: The DML contains a command that is not allowed for INITDN$ production apply.
labels.dmlValidationSingleMerge: Production-apply DML must contain exactly one MERGE statement.
labels.dmlValidationSingleUpdate: Production-apply DML must contain exactly one matched-row UPDATE.
labels.dmlValidationIdentifierScope: The DML cannot reference an owner, table, or column outside the generated editing scope.
labels.dmlValidationFunctionScope: The DML cannot use a function or callable expression outside the generated editing scope.
labels.dmlValidationExecutionScope: The DML can reference only the selected editing work history.
labels.buttonEditDmlHelp: Load the selected DML into the editor below.
labels.executedDmlDeleteBlocked: Executed DML cannot be deleted because its audit history must be retained.
labels.dmlDeleteTargetMissing: The DML to delete could not be found. Refresh the list and try again.
labels.unsavedDmlDeleteBlocked: This DML has not been saved yet. Create a new DML or switch to another saved DML.
labels.unsavedDmlRemoved: The unsaved DML was removed from the list.
labels.confirmDeleteDml:
Delete DML #{id} · {name}?
Deleted saved DML cannot be recovered.
labels.dmlRegenerateRequired: The saved DML differs from the latest server-generated SQL. Generate the DML again.
labels.dmlRowMappingStale: The editing row cannot be mapped safely to the current source row. Reset the current corrections or verify the registered case key.
labels.dmlOracleSyntaxInvalid: The generated production-apply DML is not valid Oracle SQL.
labels.dmlCustomOracleSyntaxInvalid: The custom UPDATE DML is not valid Oracle SQL.

labels.noEditingRuleTables: No INITUP$ table has final rules registered in Rule Master.
labels.selectEditingTableForHistory: Select a table to view its correction history.

labels.readOnlyUntilEditingTable: Read-only until the editing table is created
labels.userAssociationFormatHelp: Rows matching the IF condition are violations when the target value differs from the THEN result.
labels.userSymbolicFormatHelp: Build f(X) from numeric features. A row is a violation when actual and predicted values exceed the tolerance.
labels.selectVisibleMasterRules: Select all discovered rules on this page

Exclude the selected {count} discovered rules?
They will also appear as excluded on the Rule Decision tab.

The previous operational apply is complete.
Prepare {edit} again from the current {source} data and start new corrections?

labels.editingTableCreateConfirm:
Start error correction for {source} using the current active rules?
The {edit} editing table will be prepared without changing INITUP$ source data.
labels.editingTableCreating: Preparing correction work from the current rules and INITUP$ data.
labels.editingTableStructureMismatch: The INITUP$ and INITDN$ column structures do not match, so the editing table cannot be used.
labels.editingTableRequiredForSave: Create the INITDN$ editing table before saving corrections.
labels.noFinalRulesForSource: The selected source table has no final rules available for editing.
labels.buttonResetCurrentEditingHelp: Reset the current edits and unexecuted DML, then restart from INITUP$ data.
labels.selectCurrentEditingWorkToReset: Select the current work table to reset.
labels.resetCurrentEditingConfirm:
Reset the current correction work?
{changes} changed rows and {dml} unexecuted DML entries will be removed from the current work, which will restart with {rules} current rules and INITUP$ data.
labels.currentEditingWorkReset: Current corrections were reset and restarted with {count} active rules.
labels.currentEditingResetPartialFailure: The previous correction work was reset, but new work could not be prepared. Click Start error correction to retry.
labels.violationEditPanel: Live final-rule violation query and correction
labels.selectVisibleViolations: Select all violation rows on this page
labels.bulkChangeConfirm: Save corrected values for {count} selected violation rows to INITDN$?
labels.singleChangeSaved: The corrected value was saved to the INITDN$ editing copy.
labels.liveSqlHelp: Shows the server-generated SQL used by Query. This button does not execute the SQL again.
labels.editingWorkStarting: Preparing the current correction work and INITDN$ table.
labels.userRuleCopyModeMessage: Review the copied user rule and then register it.
labels.ruleContextMissing: The project or scenario of the source rule row is missing. Query the rules again.
labels.validationAnalysisHelp: Applies the same final rules used by the saved edits to INITUP$ and INITDN$ to compare edit impact and rule conformance.
labels.analysisImpactDescription: Checks the edit scope and expected-value agreement while preserving the source data.
labels.analysisCategoricalDescription: Without independent labels, this reports rule-violation reduction and expected-value agreement instead of classification accuracy.
labels.analysisContinuousDescription: Compares before/after residuals against formula predictions using MAE, RMSE, and tolerance compliance.
labels.analysisReanalysisDescription: Checks whether INITDN$ Flow reanalysis is complete in addition to the same-rule comparison.
labels.analysisImpactMethod: Statistical data editing should resolve errors while minimizing changes to the source. The change rate is distinct changed rows divided by all source rows.
labels.analysisSameRuleEvaluationUnavailable: The same rules could not be applied to the current tables. Check the rule expressions and INITDN$ structure, then query again.
labels.analysisSnapshotUnavailable: This work was applied before validation snapshots were available, so its same-rule comparison cannot be reconstructed. Only change-history metrics are available.
labels.analysisGroundTruthLimitation: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, and AUC are not calculated because no independent ground-truth labels are available.
labels.analysisCategoricalMethod: The categorical rules used by the saved edits are applied again to both INITUP$ and INITDN$ and their violation counts are compared. Expected agreement measures matches to the THEN value; it is not classification accuracy.
labels.analysisContinuousMethod: For saved numeric edits, before/after residuals are compared with the stored prediction snapshot. Lower MAE/RMSE and higher tolerance compliance indicate better rule conformance.
labels.analysisNrmseDefinition: Normalized RMSE is post-edit RMSE divided by the mean absolute prediction saved with the edits.
labels.analysisFullModelLimitation: These are changed-row editing-effect metrics, not full-dataset R² or cross-validation performance.
labels.analysisReanalysisMethod: Flow reanalysis compares stored violation counts for selected target columns. Because rule IDs or formulas can change during rediscovery, review this together with the direct same-rule comparison.
labels.analysisReviewConfirm: Some validation indicators require review. Have you reviewed the details and want to complete effect validation in this state?

messages.Complete effect validation before operat: Complete effect validation before operational DML execution.
messages.The same-rule effect analysis must compl: The same-rule effect analysis must complete before validation. Check the rule expressions and INITDN$ structure, then query again.
messages.A review-status effect analysis must be: Review the effect analysis details and explicitly acknowledge the review status.
messages.Cancelled editing execution is read-only: A cancelled editing execution is read-only for DML work.
messages.Custom UPDATE DML must contain exactly o: Custom UPDATE DML must contain exactly one statement without a semicolon.
messages.Custom UPDATE DML contains a command or: Custom UPDATE DML contains a command or subquery that is not allowed.
messages.Custom UPDATE DML target could not be id: The target table of the custom UPDATE DML could not be identified.
messages.Custom DML can target only the current I: Custom DML can target only the current INITUP$ source table.
messages.Custom UPDATE DML must include both SET: Custom UPDATE DML must include both SET and WHERE clauses.
messages.Custom UPDATE DML contains a function ou: Custom UPDATE DML contains a function outside the allowed list.
messages.DML must be a single custom UPDATE or th: DML must be a single custom UPDATE or the server-generated editing MERGE block.
